verses.text: A gentle answer can cool someone's fury. A harsh word just gets them heated.
Wise people make knowledge worth listening to. Fools spill nonsense as soon as they open their mouths.
The LORD sees everywhere, keeping an eye on people who do evil and people who do good.
Gentle words are a tree of life. Twisted words can crush someone's spirit.
A fool rolls their eyes at their father's correction. A sensible person takes it to heart.
There's plenty of treasure in the home of people who do right. What the wicked earn brings them trouble.
Wise people spread knowledge when they speak. You won't find that coming from a fool's heart.
The LORD can't stand the sacrifices of the wicked. The prayers of honest people make him glad.
The LORD can't stand the road the wicked take. He loves people who chase after what's right.
Walk off the right road and you'll face hard discipline. Hate being corrected and you'll die.
Even the grave and the place of destruction are open before the LORD. How much more can he see into human hearts!
Mockers hate being corrected. They won't go to anyone wise.
A happy heart puts a smile on your face. Heartache can break your spirit.
Someone with understanding is always looking to learn. Fools feed on nonsense.
For someone in misery, every day feels awful. With a cheerful heart, life is a feast that keeps going.
Better to have a little and stand in awe of the LORD than have piles of treasure with trouble.
A plate of greens served with love beats a feast of fattened calf served with hate.
A hothead gets fights started. Someone who's slow to anger settles them down.
A lazy person's road is like a patch full of thorns. The road of honest people is wide open.
A wise son makes his dad glad. A foolish man looks down on his mom.
People with no wisdom get a kick out of foolishness. Someone with understanding stays on a straight road.
Plans fall apart without advice. Get plenty of good advisers and those plans can stand.
It feels good to give the right answer. A word at the right time can do so much.
For wise people, the road to life goes uphill and keeps them from heading down to the grave.
The LORD tears out a proud person's house by the roots, but he keeps a widow's property lines safe.
The LORD is disgusted by the plans of wicked people, but the thoughts of people with clean hearts please him.
Chase money at any cost and you'll bring trouble home. Hate bribes and you'll live.
People who do right think carefully before answering. The wicked let evil pour straight out of their mouths.
The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayers of people who do right.
A bright look lifts the heart. Good news gives strength all the way down to your bones.
Listen when someone corrects you and you'll live and find your place among wise people.
Reject correction and you're treating your own soul with contempt. Listen to it and you'll gain understanding.
Standing in awe of the LORD teaches you wisdom. Humility comes before honor.
